messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "nutritional supplements"
set: ["nutritional supplements", "mineral supplements", "potassium supplements", "iron supplements", "over-the-counter supplements", "supplements containing biotin", "supplements containing potassium", "low potassium can be managed with potassium supplements", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "includes dietary changes and taking calcium and vitamin supplements", "do not start potassium supplements or different diuretics yourself", "check with healthcare provider before using over-the-counter products, vitamins, or herbal supplements", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless doctor has told you to", "use potassium supplements or salt substitutes only if doctor has told you to", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes containing potassium unless specifically told by doctor", "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
